_comment: Image manifest for TesterTech.html. Each entry maps a placeholder slug to a KIE.ai generation request. Run `pwsh scripts/gen-images.ps1` to (re)generate. Files land in gadget_assets/<slug>.png. The script skips slugs whose output file already exists; pass -Force to regenerate, or -Only slug1,slug2 to target specific images.
